description: European Medicines Agency Paediatric Investigation Plans (PIPs) — the agreed or waived plan for studying a medicine in children, required for most new EU marketing-authorisation applications. Returns the active substance, invented name (if assigned), therapeutic area, condition/indication under study, decision type (agreement, modification, waiver, compliance check) and decision date. Answers "what paediatric studies has the EMA required for X", "is there an EU paediatric investigation plan for drug X", "recent EMA paediatric decision for asthma".

decision_type.description: Filter on decision type text, e.g. "waiver", "agreeing on", "compliance". Substring match.

query.description: Free text: active substance, invented name, or condition/indication text.

since.description: Earliest decision date. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY.

name: ema_pip
title: Ema Pip
